_doc: Words with which the operator speaks of other sessions. helpers/session-areas.cjs (UserPromptSubmit) matches the prompt against these regexes (case-insensitive) and, on a hit, injects the live session map (who, which areas, which overlaps) with the order to coordinate now. Triggers are English; an instance adds its language in .claude/rules/session-areas.json ({"triggers": ["regex", ...]}).
